_comment: View scheme of the native pair selection window: the fields of the Qt FRETPairSelectionWindow (same labels, ranges and defaults). The three file rows are a custom section drawn by the window.

sections.title: Input
sections.description: The trajectory to select pairs from and how to read it.
Choose a trajectory, its optional topology and an optional FPS JSON defining candidate labeling pairs.

sections.label: Stride
sections.description: Read every n-th frame of the trajectory (1 = all frames).

sections.title: Candidate sites from residues
sections.description: Used when no FPS JSON is given: every pair of the listed residues is a candidate.

sections.label: Chain
sections.description: Chain of the residues: its identifier, or its index (empty = the first chain).

sections.label: Residues (PDB resSeq)
sections.description: Residue numbers as written in the PDB file: single numbers and ranges, e.g. 35-50,85-95,115-120.

sections.label: Attachment atom
sections.description: The atom the dye is attached at (CB falls back to CA where a residue has none, e.g. glycine).

sections.title: Efficiency
sections.description: How the FRET efficiency of a candidate pair is computed in every frame.

sections.label: R0 (Å)
sections.description: Forster radius of the dye pair, in Angstrom (a pair the FPS JSON gives its own R0 keeps it).

sections.label: Use AV backend
sections.description: With an FPS JSON: compute the efficiency from the accessible volumes of the dyes instead of the attachment-atom distance (falls back to the distance, with a message, when the AV cannot be computed).

sections.label: AV samples
sections.description: Distance samples drawn between the two accessible volumes of a pair, per frame.

sections.label: Max AV points
sections.description: Largest number of points kept of an accessible volume.

sections.title: Selection
sections.description: How the informative pairs are chosen.

sections.label: Expected E error
sections.description: The experimental uncertainty of a FRET efficiency; a pair is informative to the extent the conformations differ by more than this.

sections.label: Unique pairs only
sections.description: Choose every pair at most once.

sections.label: RMSD atom selection
sections.description: The atoms the conformations are compared on (an MDTraj-style selection, e.g. name CA); empty = all atoms.
